items.text: Arizona QB: Carson Beck (back) DNP Wed and Thu; Josh Johnson expected to start again. Gardner Minshew on season-ending IR.

Arizona (Wed practice): OG Jon Gaines II (ankle) DNP after setback; LB Cody Simon limited. Out for season - WRs Michael Wilson, Kendrick Bourne, Jalen Brooks; IR - RB Jeremiyah Love, S Andrew Wingard.

Washington (Wed est./Thu): DNP - WR Stefon Diggs (personal), CB Amik Robertson (ankle). LIMITED - WR Treylon Burks, DE Charles Omenihu. FULL - QB Jayden Daniels (left hand/elbow). WR Terry McLaurin out for season. Daniels starts.
